podcast.title: Departure from Band
podcast.body: Shortly after Ray Davis committed seriously to The Ram Rods (who became The Bull Weevils), John Start decided to leave the group. He chose to "grow up, get serious, give up the drums, and become a quantity surveyor." A significant factor in his decision was his strong dislike for Ray Davis, whom he considered an "unpleasant troubled person." "John start decided it was time to grow up, get serious, give up the drums, and become a quantity surveyor."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Lead Singer Audition
podcast.body: John Start's mother refused to let his early band (the Ray Davis Quartet) rehearse at her house because she thought the "young lad's raspy voice was so awful" after he sang with them at a couple of gigs. "John Start's mother thought the young lad's raspy voice was so awful she wouldn't let them use her house to rehearse."
